title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Protocol Error Enforcement Work Item
summary: Add focused fatal protocol-error handling for malformed DoQ messages on the one-query stream path.
planned_changes:
- Add a DoQ stream helper that reads exactly one DNS message and requires STREAM FIN.
- Reject non-zero DNS Message IDs on received DoQ queries and responses.
- Reject incomplete length-prefixed messages when STREAM FIN arrives early.
- Reject more than one query on a server-side query stream.
- Add focused loopback tests and a requirement-home test for the covered protocol-error requirements.
verification_plan: Run the DoQ stream lifecycle tests, the RFC 9250 requirement-home tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: Unexpected response count for AXFR/IXFR or other multi-response streams.
Client fatal handling for peer STOP_SENDING.
Missing expected STREAM FIN timeout policy.
Unidirectional and server-initiated stream fatal handling.
completion_notes: The one-query DoQ path now rejects non-zero received DNS Message IDs, incomplete DoQ frames, and multiple client queries on one stream with `DOQ_PROTOCOL_ERROR`.
